decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Statement (dated: 08/2016), WR-01, WR-02, WR-03, WR-04, WR-12, WR-13, Basement Method Statement (24/08/2016), Received: 08/09/2016. WR-14 Rev A, Received: 20/10/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the second floor rear extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Enlargement of existing semi-basement into a full-height basement, second floor rear extension and rear roof extension with front roof windows to the house.
